DISTRIBUTION AND HABITAT So far, Pierella lena atlantica ssp. nov. seems to be restricted to the Atlantic Forest of Bahia, Brazil (Fig. 3), and it is the only subspecies of the P. lena group that presents a non-Amazonian distribution. The type locality is in the RPPN “ Fazenda Lontra / Saudade ” (FLS), Itanagra at the northern coast of Bahia (12 ° 15.00 ’ S, 38 ° 0.00 ’ W). FLS has 1,377.33 ha and represents the largest area of particularly protected Atlantic Forest, located between the ParaguaÇu (BA) and São Francisco (SE) Rivers. Additionally, Zacca (2009) recorded the occurrence of P. lena atlantica (as P. lena) in the “ Recôncavo ” and southern coast of Bahia, in Cachoeira and Una, respectively.
